02 / THE PROCESS

Clarity comes before pixels.

Understand.
Make.
Refine.

Good interfaces start with good questions. I connect user needs, business goals, and the details that make a product work.

01

Discover the problem

Understand the people, their needs, and the context behind the product.

02

Find the simplest path

Organize information, map user flows, and explore ideas through wireframes.

03

Bring it into focus

Build clear interfaces, consistent components, and interactive Figma prototypes.

04

Refine together

Use feedback and work with developers to make the experience practical and consistent.

I'm Moeed Naik, a UI/UX designer building useful digital products for web and mobile.

My work spans SaaS, healthcare, fintech, marketplaces, and B2B/B2C platforms. I move from research and information architecture through wireframes, interaction design, and developer-ready prototypes.

I collaborate with clients and development teams, including US and UK stakeholders, to balance usability, accessibility, and technical constraints.
